description: Policy Engine — unified authorization for layered tokens and entry points (spec only, no implementation this round)
wave_rationale: D5: depends on per-op signing (hexon_delta_format, wave 1). Policy engine + sync-write-path evaluate() gate + causal-DAG membership. Blocks real replication.
dependency_notes: depends_on hexon_delta_format_20260710: per-op ed25519 signing, decisions D5-1 — engine verifies op signatures. blocks analytics_extension_api_20260710: capability generalization, non-blocking (track archived in conductor/tracks/_archive/). blocks p2p_mycelium_completion_20260701: sync write path must be gated before/with real iroh-docs.
notes: IMPLEMENTATION SLICE STARTED 2026-07-15 (spec_only -> in_progress). LANDED: (1) new fe-policy crate — Policy trait, AuthContext/Action/Scope/Decision, PolicyEngine (deny-by-default, tests prove empty set denies), AnyOf/AllOf, PermissiveMigrationPolicy, RoleLevelPolicy/PublicReadPolicy/CapabilityPolicy, tracing decision log (allow=debug, deny=warn); RoleLevel moved here canonically (fe-database re-exports). (2) fe-database rbac.rs: WRITE_ROLES string list deleted, require_write_role delegates to the engine (signatures stable, pure evaluate_write helper + tests). (3) fe-hexon Phase 8.4 gap: authz.rs gates install_as/uninstall_as (Editor+) with public list/search reads; tests cover allowed-role/insufficient/absent-auth. (4) fe-sync §D1 gate: handle_write_row_entry calls PolicyHandle.allow_write before applying rows — defaults to PermissiveMigrationPolicy (warn-logs would-be denies) because peer roles are not plumbed to the sync thread yet. (5) thin adapters: fe-plugin host_env require() -> CapabilityPolicy engine; fe-webview TabVisibilityFilter reads engine Manage decision. DEFERRED: fe-api auth.rs adapter (another agent owns fe-api; logged follow-up); fe-hexon-registry HTTP service routing through *_as variants; causal-DAG membership ops + strong-removal resolver (BLOCKED on per-op ed25519 signing, decisions D5-1); TokenScopePolicy/OwnershipPolicy; flipping fe-sync to strict once role plumbing lands. Original spec notes: AMENDED 2026-07-11 per conductor/decisions/hexon-p2p-commons-20260711.md — sync write path is the highest-priority adapter; auth state NEVER plain LWW.

alignment.rationale: Deny-by-default Policy::evaluate = backbone for RBAC-on-query-results. Promote spec->impl, minimal slice first.
